children: Electric vehicle maker Tesla Inc. (TSLA, Financials) has introduced a cheaper Model 3 in Hong Kong and Macau as it continues to use price to preserve demand.
In Hong Kong, the base rear-wheel-drive Model 3 costs HK$205,000, or approximately $26,000. In Macau, it costs 252,000 patacas, or about $31,000.

That's an 8.5 per cent decrease from the previous entry-level price in Hong Kong. The reduced sticker price itself is not the crucial question for investors. That's what the cut indicates about Tesla's pricing power.

A cheaper Model 3 might expand the pool of possible customers and enable Tesla to compete more aggressively in competitive Asian EV marketplaces. But continuous price cuts can also squeeze car margins if lower prices are not compensated by higher volumes or lower production costs.
With competition heating up and consumers having access to more lower priced electric vehicles, Tesla has been increasingly looking at affordability.
That makes the new Model 3 yet another test of whether Tesla can stimulate demand without sacrificing too much profitability.
Investors will be watching to see if the lower price boosts delivery in Hong Kong and Macau and if similar price cuts spread to other regions.

title: Tesla Just Cut the Model 3 Entry Price by 8.5%
